subject: Move-in inventory report – C, 35 Upper St, London, N1 0PN
body:
Dear Mr. Smith,

I moved into C, 35 Upper St, London, N1 0PN today. Please find attached my inventory report, which records the condition of the property at move-in, with photos and timestamps for every issue.

I am sending this so that we have a clear shared record, and so that none of the issues below are charged to me from the deposit at the end of the tenancy.

Issues noted

Kitchen:
- Wall cabinet door bottom trim: wood-effect trim worn, with the finish peeling and scuffed along its length (cosmetic, already present).
- Wall cabinet door bottom trim (corner): worn and chipped finish on the corner of another cabinet door's trim (cosmetic, already present).
- Wall cabinet underside trim / pelmet: a section appears broken or missing, leaving a gap (cosmetic, already present).
- Cable under wall cabinet: loose cable draped exposed along the underside of the trim, not clipped or concealed (landlord to repair).
- Worktop to wall tile joint by sink: dark gap where sealant is missing or has failed (landlord to repair).
- Washing machine door seal: black mould or dirt build-up on the rubber seal (please confirm who is responsible).
- Washing machine front panel: torn sticker and adhesive residue (cosmetic, already present).

Repairs requested

Please could you arrange for the exposed cable under the wall cabinet to be made safe and properly clipped or concealed, and for the missing or failed sealant between the worktop and wall tiles by the sink to be replaced. I would be grateful if you could confirm a date for these repairs.

Could you also let me know in writing who is responsible for dealing with the mould or dirt on the washing machine door seal, so I can keep your reply for my records.

For reference
- Landlord repairs (electrical wiring; sinks and their pipes and drains): GOV.UK – Private renting: repairs, https://www.gov.uk/private-renting/repairs
- Items to confirm (washing machine seal): GOV.UK – Private renting: repairs, https://www.gov.uk/private-renting/repairs
- Pre-existing cosmetic issues and deposit deductions: Shelter – Deposit deductions for damage and missing items, https://england.shelter.org.uk/housing_advice/tenancy_deposits/what_can_your_landlord_deduct_from_your_deposit/damage_and_missing_items

Please could you confirm receipt of this email and the attached report in writing. I will keep a copy of the report with my deposit protection paperwork.

Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

Anant Shah
